rounding: All dollar amounts are rounded to the nearest $10 for display and in model outputs. Percentages are unrounded.

status_key.V-PRIMARY: Read from an official page or document in this session
status_key.V-SNIPPET: Official page located; text read from search result
status_key.S-SECONDARY: Non-official reproduction; cross-check only; UNVERIFIED until primary check
status_key.OWNER: Owner-provided figure (internal record or estimate); not verified online
status_key.ASSUMPTION: Model assumption; not an official data value; reasoning given

inputs.label: Tax rate, official county sample (used as low case)

inputs.note: SSA 2025 Trustees ultimate CPI: 1.8 / 2.4 / 3.0 (high-cost / intermediate / low-cost). Fed longer-run objective 2.0 (S19) is the policy target.

inputs.note: Base: homes keep pace with inflation. Historical drawdown evidence (about -30% 2006-2009, S18) is handled in the black-swan scenarios, not here.

inputs.label: Real rent growth above inflation
inputs.note: Assumed.

inputs.label: 2-year Treasury yield
inputs.note: 4.63% on 24 Nov 2026 (S01). Low and high are assumptions.

inputs.label: Equity expected nominal return (incl. dividends)

inputs.note: Assumed.

inputs.note: Policy assumption (see investing policy page; not a recommendation).

inputs.label: Combined marginal income tax on rental income (federal + CA)
inputs.note: Federal 24% bracket (single, $105,700-$201,775, S02); CA rate for the household not verified. Replace with the household's actual marginal rate.

inputs.label: Federal long-term capital gain rate on sale
inputs.note: 15% applies above the 0% threshold (single $49,450; MFJ $98,900); 20% above $545,500 single / $613,700 MFJ (S02). Household income not known.

inputs.label: Net investment income tax
inputs.note: 3.8% above $200,000 single / $250,000 MFJ modified AGI (not indexed). Applied to rental and sale gains in the base case.

inputs.label: California tax on capital gains and rental income
inputs.note: Base 9.3% and low 6.0% are ASSUMED placeholders. High 12.3% is the top regular rate reported by a secondary source (S32, unverified). Plus 1% Mental Health Services Tax above $1,000,000 taxable income (S07). Must be replaced from the FTB rate schedule.

inputs.label: Federal rate on unrecaptured Section 1250 gain (depreciation)
inputs.note: 25% maximum (secondary reproduction of IRS Pub 527/Sch. D). Primary check required.

inputs.label: Depreciation life, residential rental building
inputs.note: Straight-line 27.5 years (IRS Pub 527). Primary check required.

inputs.label: Building share of value (depreciable)
inputs.note: Assumed. Land is not depreciable; replace with the appraisal split.

inputs.label: Section 121 exclusion on sale of main home (single filer)
inputs.note: $250,000 single, $500,000 MFJ (S05). Base assumes single filer; the household's filing status is unknown (question Q-12).

inputs.label: Years lived in Property A before sale (living-then-sell path)
inputs.note: Two years of use satisfies the 2-of-5 use test (S05); used as the living period in the living-then-sell path.

inputs.label: Months parked in 3M-2Y Treasuries before phasing into stocks
inputs.note: User-specified range 24-36 months.
